title: RuleBox 1.0.0
body: RuleBox 1.0.0 Archived version. This page preserves the RuleBox 1.0.0 docs as originally written. For the current release, see the Latest docs . RuleBox is a modern intuitive and natural language rule engine based upon the great work of RuleBook : https://github.com/rulebook-rules/rulebook ported over to BoxLang.
